purpose: One-shot full three-topic worker qualification using the frozen 15-slot assignments, with exact-goal-scoped three-item task-only numerical authoring and unchanged five-item Python/mixed authoring.

goal.title: Exact rational arithmetic and bounded conditions
goal.learningTarget: Exact rational arithmetic and bounded conditions
goal.questionDirective: Evaluate exact expressions using addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, or solve an explicitly stated bounded integer condition. Vary the operations. Preserve the distinction between any satisfying value and an explicitly requested minimum or maximum. Use complete numerical tasks without stories or unstated physical assumptions. Aim for difficulty 2 or 3.

goal.title: Python 3 expressions
goal.questionDirective: Use complete short Python 3 expressions or correctly indented code, with explicit values. Preserve case and literal syntax. Vary the expressions and test application of Python semantics at difficulty 2 or 3. The subject is Python behavior, not arithmetic alone.

goal.title: Arithmetic and English application practice
goal.questionDirective: Cover both assigned skills with self-contained application questions at difficulty 2 or 3. Arithmetic questions use complete exact expressions or explicitly bounded integer conditions. English questions supply complete sentences in standard written American English and make the tested agreement or pronoun-reference distinction explicit.

objectives.name: Evaluate an exact rational expression or explicit bounded condition
Apply subject-verb agreement or unambiguous pronoun reference

qualification_route: Call current-source _generate_sanitized_questions once per exact frozen job under the new exact-goal-scoped numerical batch cap. Only the numerical job uses question_author_tasks_v1 and first target three; unallocated Python and mapped mixed retain five-item constructed authoring. The runtime alone owns author top-ups, compiler, sanitizer, solver, immutable audit and partial returns.
capture_protocol: A separate one-shot metadata-only launch precheck must precede freeze: use the reviewed default login profile in a child-controlled endpoint environment for one explicit STS GetCallerIdentity request, then the pinned CLI export. Reject any inherited AWS_ENDPOINT_URL* override before credential resolution and validate the resolved STS endpoint before its signed request. One Botocore Signin refresh and one CLI Signin refresh may accompany the STS operation; budget at most three pretrial AWS operations, with zero model calls. CLI ancillary Signin activity cannot be directly observed in this capture. Require account 239342516379, exported expiry at least 840 seconds away, and a precheck record with no credential values. Freeze and execute require that record to match the exact draft digest and still have at least 810 seconds remaining; execute then independently requires at least 780 seconds in its own snapshot. This precheck is outside the fifteen-slot and eighteen-call model trial.

At freeze, pin the exact executable harness, tests, all 29 runtime modules, requirements, template, bounded capture helper, three initial author prompts and both native author contracts before acquiring credentials.

Create an exclusive no-resume capture with three original jobs, fifteen question slots and eighteen unattempted call slots before credential acquisition. Fsync the capture file and parent directory after initial creation and each atomic replacement, including every reservation, exact request, and attempted-dispatch marker before Converse.

Use one explicit default-profile credential export through the pinned AWS CLI 2.33.15 executable for a single boto3 session. Before export, reject AWS_CONFIG_FILE and AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE overrides; verify the exact reviewed ~/.aws/config path and SHA-256, its default profile with only login_session and us-east-1 region (login-session value retained only as a SHA-256 fingerprint), and no shared-credentials default section. The child process receives the pinned HOME/config/credentials paths, keeps the login cache, removes inherited AWS credential-source and AWS_ENDPOINT_URL* variables, and sets AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS=true to neutralize service endpoint overrides during any Signin refresh. Require a parsed, timezone-aware expiration at least 780 seconds after export (three 240-second job windows plus 60 seconds for setup/inter-job overhead; stop dispatch when the remaining credential life cannot cover the deadline-clamped read plus connect and safety margin), and recheck remaining snapshot lifetime against the dispatch read plus connect timeout and safety margin immediately before every Converse. Reject wrong profiles, validate the resolved exact STS endpoint before a signed identity request, require account 239342516379, then use that same session for Bedrock. A failed identity check leaves all original slots unattempted.

Record actual job/pass/raw-row/source-order/compiled-spec/sanitized/verified/returned provenance. Numerical author payloads must be task-only; Python and mixed author payloads retain the constructed union schema. Retain extra rows only as diagnostics and never replace a planned slot.

At each dispatch verify source, request, model, native schema, endpoint, us-east-1 region, three-second connect ceiling, deadline-clamped read timeout at most 200 seconds, and exactly one SDK attempt. Recheck the remaining deadline after all pin and capture writes immediately before the underlying Converse call.
Bound response capture, remove reasoning and signatures, scan raw visible and decoded duplicate JSON members for credential echo before persistence, and save only safe error type/code.
Check capture digest against external modification and recheck all source and request pins after each call and at finalization. Missing response usage remains unknown.
independent_review_protocol: After capture, project all 15 original slots as opaque IDs with exact stem and rotated choices; include explicit missing placeholders. Hide arm, key, explanation, author and auditor claims.
Lock independent literal solution, four choice statuses and six pair meanings for every slot before opening private mapping, authored key, teaching or model judgments. Uncertainty fails an item.
Then inspect every authored key and all visible main/choice teaching, scope, difficulty at least two, novelty, exact compiler fields, policy revision and empty prose choice feedback.

For Python, evaluate exact values and short-circuit order and refute universal first-truthy/first-falsy claims with absent-trigger final-operand examples. For English, preserve American notional plural alternatives where the stem lacks unit/member disambiguation.
failure_policy: Ordinary provider, timeout, safety, malformed, model-review and deadline failures consume their reserved call and original slots; later independent jobs remain eligible. Global credential/SDK setup, source/request/contract/provenance/capture integrity, unsafe output or budget overrun stops all work. No retry, rescue, fallback, warmup, cache flush, replacement job, or second run.
offline_prerequisites: Review frozen current-source worker plan/capture/results hashes and preserve their bytes. Use only this candidate directory for new plan, precheck and capture.
Use pinned Python 3.12.11 and dependency search path; do not use system Python 3.9.
Independently review the exact-goal-scoped batch-cap source delta, three fixed requests, both author contracts, all three first prompt/schema hashes, durable harness, and socket-blocked tests.
Run full backend suite and candidate harness tests offline. Preflight requires pinned Python, boto3/botocore 1.43.91, awscrt 0.36.0, and AWS CLI 2.33.15; CLI --version is offline.
Review the generated draft digest, then separately freeze the exact plan only after independent GO.

After GO, run --launch-precheck once, inspect metadata-only freshness record, --freeze with reviewed digest, hash and commit frozen plan, then invoke one --execute while precheck snapshot retains at least 810 seconds. No precheck, freeze or model calls during preparation.

estimated_calls.planning_estimate: Up to 18 Converse attempts; numerical may need two author/audit passes within six calls, then Python and mixed retain prior routes. Zero authorized during preparation.

claim_limits: One fresh 15-slot full-worker sample on reused assignments; not a paired causal estimate or population reliability estimate. It does not qualify defaults, deployed Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB or inventory refill. The exact-goal batch-cap source delta is candidate-only until full qualification.

launch_precheck.scope: one-shot separate pretrial refresh and metadata-only freshness proof; a durable attempt marker precedes at most one explicit STS request and no trial capture, model call or frozen plan is created by precheck
